title: Voice to Text
tagline: Turn a Telegram voice message into text, fully offline. Share a voice note straight into the app or open an audio file; the speech is recognised on your device with no cloud and no account — Ukrainian, Russian and English, with the language chosen automatically. Models download once and then work with the network unplugged.
